320: def junit(path, expected):
321:     root = ET.fromstring(path.read_bytes())
322:     nodes = root.findall('.//testcase')
323:     names = [item.get('classname', '').replace('.', '/') + '.py::' + item.get('name', '') for item in nodes]
324:     failures = [item for item in nodes if item.find('failure') is not None]
325:     errors = [item for item in nodes if item.find('error') is not None]
326:     skips = [item for item in nodes if item.find('skipped') is not None]
327:     return {'tests': len(nodes), 'passes': len(nodes) - len(failures) - len(errors) - len(skips),
328:             'failures': len(failures), 'errors': len(errors), 'skips': len(skips), 'nodeids': names,
329:             'names_exact': names == expected,
330:             'failure_details': [{'nodeid': names[nodes.index(item)], 'text': ET.tostring(item, encoding='unicode')} for item in failures]}
